AddUserToVpcEndpointService.title: AddUserToVpcEndpointService
AddUserToVpcEndpointService.summary: Adds an account ID to the whitelist of an endpoint service.

AddZoneToVpcEndpoint.title: AddZoneToVpcEndpoint
AddZoneToVpcEndpoint.summary: Adds a zone to an endpoint.

AttachResourceToVpcEndpointService.title: AttachResourceToVpcEndpointService
AttachResourceToVpcEndpointService.summary: Adds a service resource to an endpoint service.

AttachSecurityGroupToVpcEndpoint.title: AttachSecurityGroupToVpcEndpoint
AttachSecurityGroupToVpcEndpoint.summary: Associates an endpoint with a security group.

CreateVpcEndpointService.title: Create an endpoint service
CreateVpcEndpointService.summary: Calls the CreateVpcEndpointService operation to create an endpoint service.

DescribeRegions.title: Query regions supported by privateLink
DescribeRegions.summary: Queries the regions that support PrivateLink.

DescribeZones.title: Query zones supported by privateLink
DescribeZones.summary: Queries the list of zones supported by PrivateLink in a specified region. In cross-region scenarios, the zones supported on the endpoint side and the endpoint service side are independent of each other. This operation allows you to query the supported zones for the endpoint side and the endpoint service side separately.

DetachResourceFromVpcEndpointService.title: DetachResourceFromVpcEndpointService
DetachResourceFromVpcEndpointService.summary: Removes a service resource from an endpoint service.

DetachSecurityGroupFromVpcEndpoint.title: DetachSecurityGroupFromVpcEndpoint
DetachSecurityGroupFromVpcEndpoint.summary: Disassociates an endpoint from a security group.

DisableVpcEndpointConnection.title: DisableVpcEndpointConnection
DisableVpcEndpointConnection.summary: Rejects a connection request from an endpoint.

DisableVpcEndpointZoneConnection.title: DisableVpcEndpointZoneConnection
DisableVpcEndpointZoneConnection.summary: Closes connections in an endpoint zone.

EnableVpcEndpointConnection.title: Accept an endpoint connection request
EnableVpcEndpointConnection.summary: Calls the EnableVpcEndpointConnection operation, and the endpoint service accepts the connection request from the endpoint.

GetVpcEndpointAttribute.title: Query endpoint attributes
GetVpcEndpointAttribute.summary: Queries the attributes of an endpoint.

GetVpcEndpointServiceAttribute.title: GetVpcEndpointServiceAttribute
GetVpcEndpointServiceAttribute.summary: Call `GetVpcEndpointServiceAttribute` to retrieve the properties of an endpoint service in your account.

ListTagResources.title: ListTagResources
ListTagResources.summary: Queries the tags that are added to resources.

ListVpcEndpointConnections.title: Query endpoint connections
ListVpcEndpointConnections.summary: Queries endpoint connections by calling the ListVpcEndpointConnections operation.

ListVpcEndpointSecurityGroups.title: ListVpcEndpointSecurityGroups
ListVpcEndpointSecurityGroups.summary: Queries the security group that is associated with an endpoint.

ListVpcEndpointServiceResources.title: ListVpcEndpointServiceResources
ListVpcEndpointServiceResources.summary: Queries the service resources that are added to an endpoint service.

ListVpcEndpointServiceUsers.title: ListVpcEndpointServiceUsers
ListVpcEndpointServiceUsers.summary: Queries the whitelist of an endpoint service.

ListVpcEndpointServices.title: ListVpcEndpointServices
ListVpcEndpointServices.summary: Call the ListVpcEndpointServices operation to query the endpoint services owned by your account.

ListVpcEndpointServicesByEndUser.title: ListVpcEndpointServicesByEndUser
ListVpcEndpointServicesByEndUser.summary: Call the ListVpcEndpointServicesByEndUser operation to retrieve a list of endpoint services for which the current account is whitelisted. This list includes services that you can connect to by creating new endpoints, as well as services that are already connected to your existing ones.

ListVpcEndpointZones.title: ListVpcEndpointZones
ListVpcEndpointZones.summary: Call the ListVpcEndpointZones operation to query the zones of an endpoint.

RemoveUserFromVpcEndpointService.title: Remove service whitelist
RemoveUserFromVpcEndpointService.summary: Calls the RemoveUserFromVpcEndpointService operation to remove a user account from the service whitelist of an endpoint service.

RemoveZoneFromVpcEndpoint.title: RemoveZoneFromVpcEndpoint
RemoveZoneFromVpcEndpoint.summary: Deletes a zone of an endpoint.

TagResources.title: TagResources
TagResources.summary: Adds tags to resources. You can call this API operation to add tags to one or more endpoints or endpoint services.

UntagResources.title: UntagResources
UntagResources.summary: Removes tags from one or more endpoints or endpoint services at a time.

UpdateVpcEndpointAttribute.title: Modify endpoint attributes
UpdateVpcEndpointAttribute.summary: Modifies the attributes of an endpoint.

UpdateVpcEndpointConnectionAttribute.title: Modify the attributes of an endpoint connection
UpdateVpcEndpointConnectionAttribute.summary: Calls the UpdateVpcEndpointConnectionAttribute operation to modify the attributes of an endpoint connection.

UpdateVpcEndpointServiceAttribute.title: Modify the attributes of an endpoint service
UpdateVpcEndpointServiceAttribute.summary: Calls the UpdateVpcEndpointServiceAttribute operation to modify the attributes of an endpoint service.

UpdateVpcEndpointServiceResourceAttribut.title: UpdateVpcEndpointServiceResourceAttribute
UpdateVpcEndpointServiceResourceAttribut.summary: The UpdateVpcEndpointServiceResourceAttribute operation enables or disables automatic allocation for a service resource of an endpoint service.

UpdateVpcEndpointZoneConnectionResourceA.title: UpdateVpcEndpointZoneConnectionResourceAttribute
UpdateVpcEndpointZoneConnectionResourceA.summary: Modifies a service resource of a zone to which an endpoint connection belongs.
